About the Practice

White Plains Hospital is a 292-bed not-for-profit health care organization and a member of the Montefiore Health System, serving as its tertiary hub in the Hudson Valley. [3, 4] Its primary mission is to provide exceptional acute and preventive medical care to the community in Westchester County and surrounding areas. [3] The hospital offers a wide array of advanced technology and specialty care, including comprehensive programs in cancer care, cardiac services, maternity services, neurosciences, orthopedics, pediatrics, and surgical services, as well as urgent care and various outpatient facilities. [6, 7, 12] White Plains Hospital is recognized for its high quality of care, having received a 5-Star rating from CMS, Magnet® designation for nursing excellence, and an 'A' Safety Grade from the Leapfrog Group. [3, 10, 14]

Electronic Health Record System

Epic

Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

White Plains Hospital uses MyChart as their patient portal. They transitioned to Epic, a comprehensive electronic health record system, on May 1, 2021. MyChart is the patient portal commonly used with the Epic EHR system, providing patients with access to their health information, scheduling options, and billing information.
